blocks.html: The rock socket and steel pipe shall be thoroughly cleaned of foreign materials before filling with concrete or grout. Steel cores shall be set within 6 inches (152.4 mm) above the base of the rock socket. Concrete shall not be placed through water except where a tremie or other method approved by the commissioner is used.
